availability.note: Leapmotor AU B10 page lists the BEV in two grades, Style and Design LR, with the MY26 buyer's guide; Leapmotor AU has no public configurator with prices (the /en-au/pricing calculator renders client-side). Offers page (https://www.leapmotor.net/en-au/offers) runs a BEV wall-charger offer on B10s purchased and delivered 1 Oct to 31 Dec 2026, confirming the BEV is on sale. Hybrid EV (REEV) Style/Design excluded as range-extenders.

listPrice.note: CarExpert deals roundup (31 Jul 2026): B10 EV Style 'from $37,888 plus on-road costs' (alongside a $38,990 D/A campaign for 1 Jul-30 Sep 2026, now expired). CarExpert spec page (live 2026-11-27, https://www.carexpert.com.au/leapmotor/b10/2026-style-suv-rwd-electric-jsgwmwkf20260410) 'prices starting at $37,888 before on-road costs'; CarsGuide Style review (21 Feb 2026, https://www.carsguide.com.au/ev/leapmotor-b10-style-100861) 'Starting from $37,888 before on-road costs'. No manufacturer price page is published. Victorian drive-away via calc/onroad.js: $40,359; the expired $38,990 D/A offer sat below that, i.e. a discounted campaign.

batteryKwh.note: usable, EV Database estimate (asterisked as estimated); nominal 56.2 kWh is the figure Leapmotor AU prints (unlabelled, gross) on the B10 page and MY26 buyer's guide (https://www.leapmotor.net/docs/lpmiwebsiteenaulibraries/brochures/leapmotor-b10-buyersguide-my26-v102.pdf). Same pack as the European car (LFP, 140 kW DC).

rangeKm.note: Leapmotor AU MY26 buyer's guide: EV range up to 361 km (WLTP), same table gives NEDC/ADR 81/02 up to 442 km (higher, rejected per direction test). 18-inch wheels on both grades, so the 'up to' figure is the local wheel.

consumptionKwhPer100km.note: Leapmotor AU MY26 buyer's guide: 172 Wh/km WLTP (includes charging losses); usable/range gives 15.2, within tolerance.

bootLitresSeatsUp.note: Leapmotor AU buyer's guide: rear cargo volume behind 2nd row 490 L (BEV). CarExpert spec page labels 490 L 'to lower window', i.e. to the cargo cover. EV Database's 430 L is a European figure, not used. No frunk added.

bootLitresSeatsDown.note: Leapmotor AU buyer's guide: behind 1st row 1,475 L (BEV).

towKg.note: CarsGuide 2026 towing table: Style and Design LR electric 0 kg braked (REEV 750 kg). Leapmotor AU buyer's guide lists no towing figure. EV Database gives 750 kg for the European BEV, which is not the Australian rating.

warrantyYears.note: Leapmotor AU: vehicle warranty 6 years/150,000 km, battery 8 years/160,000 km; buyer's guide agrees. Unconditional.

insuranceAnnual.note: held figure kept; anchored to byd-atto3-essential ($39,990, $1,500), mg-s5-essence-49 ($39,453, $1,500), geely-ex5-complete ($41,990, $1,600) and leapmotor-c10-style ($45,888, $1,700)

depreciationCurve.note: Leapmotor brand curve [1, 0.72, 0.59, 0.5, 0.43, 0.37], the curve held on leapmotor-c10 Style and Design LR; chosen as the single Leapmotor curve per owner convention. Below mainstream for thin local volume (~20 dealers), no resale history, heavy drive-away campaigning on B10 and C10, and a 7-to-6-year warranty cut.
